views.label: Read timetables
views.note: Baseline first, then permitted suspensions. Matching tags keep decoded IndexedDB data; small immutable projections speed local reads.

views.label: Save and publish
views.note: Absence row tokens permit unrelated saves. The owner checks current data and commits a receipt before confirming success.

views.label: Five viewports
views.note: Five viewports share contracts. Calendar pulls Contacts birthdays; Deploy exports local aSc drafts. Google sync stays explicit.

views.label: Deliver and receive
views.note: Bounded sends run separately from allocation. One verified daily Drive report clears matching review alerts, not delivery history.

views.label: Recover safely
views.note: Retry the original request. Keep drafts, durable jobs and uncertain outcomes. A saved report does not prove WhatsApp delivery.

components.label: Private Worker stores
components.sublabel: D1 jobs / R2 copies and media

cards.title: Choose the viewport
items: Calendar: dates and events. Layout: campus and venues. Contacts: people and access.
Roster: absence, relief, timetables and notices. Deploy: staff, venue plans and draft aSc XML.

cards.title: Read once; use locally
items: Load the Roster shell first. Send baseline content, then permitted suspensions for today plus 30 days.
Keep decoded content in IndexedDB. Check tags on the first Singapore-day load, hourly at :20, and after a missed check.
Matching tags avoid payload downloads. Immutable view projections and request-local teacher indexes avoid repeated copying and scans.

cards.title: Save, publish, send
items: Save to online commits the shared plan. Let teachers see releases its dated snapshot. Send WhatsApp creates eligible notification work.
An absence row token detects changes to that entry. Independent saves can merge; the owner still validates the current state.
Stable request IDs and receipts protect retries. SMC-touched allocations remain protected. A cache does not authorise a write.

cards.title: Separate background work
items: Notifications, Inbox ingestion, planning and optional Calendar continuation run as bounded tasks with their own claims.
D1 holds webhook jobs and read-build claims. R2 holds private derived copies and media. Google retains authority for school records.
At or after 08:00 Singapore, one frozen issue snapshot becomes a dated Drive text report. Verified content clears only those exact alerts.

cards.title: Pull birthdays; then sync
items: Calendar reads active non-MK staff from Contacts and creates all-day Happy Bday events in Day [SWC].
Clearing both birthday fields removes only the generated event. Missing or invalid data preserves it for review; manual events remain.
The pull saves owned events and a receipt together. Sync Staff separately updates the staff Google Calendar.

cards.title: Export local aSc XML
items: Deploy freezes the local deployment and export settings before preview or download. XML export needs no online save.
The draft describes teachers, classes, TG divisions, rooms and lesson demand. aSc decides placements and temporal rules.
Test import into a new or copied timetable. Retaining existing destination structure needs a verified ID mapping.

cards.title: Limits and recovery
items: Roster still replaces its operational Drive JSON under ScriptLock. Row tokens do not create SQL row isolation. Inbox shares that lock.
Calendar releases its write lock during Google calls. Settlement checks the claim and source; newer edits remain pending.
Retry the original request after a timeout. A delivery report clears review alerts, not the failed or uncertain WhatsApp outcome.

cards.title: Install and verify
items: Install five Pages ZIPs, four gCodes and the complete Worker text. The maintainer guide gives dashboard steps and the two Calendar birthday properties.
D1 ingestion, R2 snapshots and Calendar continuation use documented optional bindings and flags. No new Durable Object or Workflow is required.
This map describes release source, not live configuration or measured morning latency. School service checks and installed aSc import remain necessary.
Sources refer to committed local release 80ca471. The local.invalid repository label is an offline identifier, not a hosted address.
